 Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the Argentina vs Costa Rica international friendly at the Estadio Mario Kempes in Cordoba, Argentina on Wednesday, November 18! Key Updates
 GOAL: Argentina 1-0 Costa Rica - Nico Paz (8')
 Costa Rica XI
 Argentina XI
 November 18, 2026 04:49 
 15'
 Costa Rica is determined to play through Argentina, but I’m not sure how wise a strategy that is. Once again Julian Alvarez wins the ball back and plays Prestianni through, but his toe poke is blocked out for a corner.
 November 18, 2026 04:43 
 GOAL: Argentina 1-0 Costa Rica - Nico Paz (8')
 And the pressure tells! Once again it comes from Julian Alvarez finding space on the turnover. This time he gives it Enzo, who sets up Nico Paz to find the top corner. Well deserved lead for the host.
 November 18, 2026 04:41 
 7'
 Another good chance, and again it comes from Costa Rica surrendering the ball to Julian Alvarez in its own half. This time he lays it off to Nico Paz, whose shot is blocked.
 November 18, 2026 04:38 
 5'
 First big chance of the game! Julian Alvarez pounces on a loose ball on the edge of the box and lays it off to Enzo Fernandez in space. He takes a touch inside the D and lets fly, but it is wide of the post.
 November 18, 2026 04:32 
 Kick-off!
 And we’re underway! Costa Rica gets the ball rolling, who will make the first breakthrough?
 November 18, 2026 04:24 
 Team in the tunnel
 Almost ready to go in Cordoba, where both teams are in the tunnel exchanging handshakes. Hopefully we’re in for a corker. 
 Have to say the stadium is looking pretty empty.
 November 18, 2026 04:19 
 Emi Martinez returns
 Another interesting plotline tonight is the return of Emi Martinez in the Argentine goal. The veteran shotstopper suffered a serious jaw injury while playing for club side Chelsea, and will no doubt be delighted to back on the field after months out.
 November 18, 2026 03:59 
 Costa Rica XI
 Sequiera, Taylor, Calvo, Vargas, Michel, Borges, Mendez, Soto, Salazar, Mora, Ugalde.
 November 18, 2026 03:52 
 Argentina XI
 Martinez, Giay, Lisandro, Medina, Vega, Enzo, Perrone, MacAllister, Paz, Alvarez, Prestianni.
 November 18, 2026 03:44 
 Life goes on (sans Messi)
 Tonight is the second match Argentina will play after Lionel Messi’s international retirement. Its first outing was far from idea, as it surrendered to a 1-2 defeat at the hands of rival Uruguay. 
 Lionel Scaloni’s side will be keen to bounce back tonight.
 November 18, 2026 03:43 
 A popular home venue
 Tonight’s match takes place at the Estadio Mario Kempes in Cordoba. This has traditionally been a happy hunting ground for Argentina, it has won 13 of its 15 matches here.
 Can it keep that run going tonight?
 November 18, 2026 03:31 
 Welcome!
 Hello, and welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the Argentina vs Costa Rica friendly taking place in Cordoba.
 Stay with us for all of the updates from this game.
